title: November Examination
instructions: This question paper consists of 7 questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Clearly show ALL calculations. Answers only will NOT necessarily be awarded full marks.
You may use an approved scientific calculator, unless stated otherwise.
Round off answers to TWO decimal places, unless stated otherwise.
Give reasons for all statements in the geometry questions.
Diagrams are NOT necessarily drawn to scale.

sections.title: QUESTION 1: Numbers, operations and exponents
sections.instructions: Do NOT use a calculator in this question.

questions.prompt: Which number is NOT a prime number?
questions.explanation: $27 = 3 \times 9$, so it has more than two factors.

questions.prompt: Calculate $(-3) \times (-4) \div (-2)$.
Find the HCF of $48$ and $72$.
Calculate $-15 + 8 - (-4)$.
Calculate, and give the answer as a mixed number: $2\dfrac{1}{3} + 1\dfrac{3}{4}$
Calculate: $3^2 \times 2^3 - \sqrt{64} + 5^0$

(a) Write $7\ 250\ 000$ in scientific notation.  (1)
(b) Calculate $(2 \times 10^3) \times (3 \times 10^4)$ and give the answer in scientific notation.  (2)
Simplify: $\dfrac{(2x^3)^2 \times 3x^4}{6x^5}$
Three friends share R1 200 in the ratio $2 : 3 : 5$. How much does each friend get?

A cellphone costs R2 400 excluding VAT.
(a) Calculate the price including 15% VAT.  (1)
(b) During a sale, a discount of 10% is given on the price including VAT. Calculate the sale price.  (2)

Ayanda invests R12 000 at 9% simple interest per year.
(a) Calculate the interest earned after 3 years and the final amount.  (2)
(b) How many years will it take to earn R5 400 interest?  (2)

Consider the pattern $3;\ 7;\ 11;\ 15;\ \ldots$
(a) Write down the next two terms.  (1)
(b) Determine the general rule $T_n$.  (2)
(c) Calculate $T_{50}$.  (1)
For the pattern with general rule $T_n = 4n - 1$, which term (position number) is equal to $87$?
Use the rule $y = -2x + 5$ to find the output values for the inputs $x = -2$, $x = 0$ and $x = 3$.

A flow diagram multiplies the input $x$ by 3 and then subtracts 4 to give the output $y$.
(a) Write down a formula for $y$ in terms of $x$.  (1)
(b) Find the output when the input is $-2$.  (1)
(c) Find the input when the output is $26$.  (1)
What is the coefficient of $x^2$ in $4x^3 - 7x^2 + x - 9$?
questions.explanation: The term is $-7x^2$, so the coefficient is $-7$.

questions.prompt: Simplify: $5a - 3b + 2a - 7b$
Expand and simplify: $3x(2x - 5) - 2(x^2 - 4x)$
Simplify: $\dfrac{16x^4y^3 - 8x^2y}{4x^2y}$
Calculate the value of $a^2 - 3ab$ if $a = -2$ and $b = 3$.
Solve for $x$: $5x - 7 = 18$
Solve for $x$: $4(x - 2) = 2x + 6$
The sum of three consecutive even numbers is $78$. Write an equation and solve it to find the numbers.

sections.title: QUESTION 5: Geometry of straight lines and 2D shapes
sections.instructions: In the diagram, AB ∥ CD and the transversal EF cuts AB at G and CD at H. ∠EGB = 65°. Give a reason for every statement.

questions.prompt: Calculate $z$, giving a reason.
Calculate $x$, giving a reason.
Calculate $y$, giving a reason.
In $\triangle PQR$, $PQ = PR$ and $\hat{P} = 40^\circ$. $QR$ is extended to $S$. Calculate $\hat{PRQ}$ and $\hat{PRS}$, giving reasons.
questions.memo:
$\hat{Q} = \hat{PRQ}$ (∠s opp equal sides) ✓ (1)
$\hat{PRQ} = \dfrac{180^\circ - 40^\circ}{2} = 70^\circ$ (∠ sum of Δ) ✓ (1)
$\hat{PRS} = 180^\circ - 70^\circ$ (∠s on a str line) ✓ (1)
$= 110^\circ$ ✓ (1)

questions.prompt: A quadrilateral has diagonals that are equal in length and bisect each other at right angles. What is it?
questions.explanation: Equal diagonals (rectangle property) that bisect at $90^\circ$ (rhombus property): a square.

questions.prompt: The angles of a quadrilateral are $2x$, $3x$, $100^\circ$ and $80^\circ$. Calculate $x$ and the two unknown angles.
If all three angles of one triangle are equal to the three angles of another triangle, the triangles must be congruent.
questions.explanation: Equal angles (AAA) only guarantee the same shape (similar), not the same size.

questions.prompt: What is the name of a triangle in which all three sides have different lengths?
In $\triangle ABC$, $\hat{B} = 90^\circ$, $AB = 9$ cm and $BC = 12$ cm. Calculate $AC$.
A ladder 6,5 m long leans against a vertical wall. The foot of the ladder is 2,5 m from the wall. How high up the wall does the ladder reach?
A circle has a diameter of 14 cm. Calculate (a) its circumference and (b) its area. Use the $\pi$ key.
A rectangular prism is 10 cm long, 6 cm wide and 4 cm high. Calculate (a) its volume and (b) its total surface area.

A rectangular water tank is 1,2 m long, 0,8 m wide and 0,5 m high.
(a) Calculate its volume in $\text{m}^3$.  (1)
(b) How many litres does it hold?  (1)
(c) A hose fills it at 12 litres per minute. How long does it take to fill the empty tank?  (1)

sections.title: QUESTION 7: Transformations, data handling and probability

questions.prompt:
Point $M$ is $(-3;\ 5)$.
(a) Write down the image of $M$ after a reflection in the $x$-axis.  (1)
(b) Write down the image of $M$ after a translation 2 units right and 4 units down.  (1)
The number of goals scored by a soccer team in seven matches was: $7;\ 3;\ 9;\ 5;\ 3;\ 8;\ 6$. Calculate the mean, median, mode and range.

(a) A bag contains 4 red, 6 white and 2 black balls. One ball is taken at random. Find $P(\text{white})$ and $P(\text{not black})$.  (2)
(b) A coin is tossed and a die is rolled. How many outcomes are possible, and what is the probability of a tail and a number greater than 4?  (2)
